title: Razkadr vector index manifest
description: Embedding stage output (naryad 010): manifest of a vector store. See docs/artifacts.md.

provider.description: Embedding provider id from the provider layer (naryad 033).

model.description: Embedding model name as requested from the provider.

version.description: Provider-reported model version, pinned for reproducibility.

dim.description: Vector dimensionality; every vector in the store has this length.

num_vectors.description: Number of vectors in the store.

vectors_file.description: Path of the vector payload file, relative to the run directory (index/*).

space.description: Logical vector space name (frames, chunks, ocr); hybrid search (naryad 012) reads several manifests.

schemaVersion.description: Artifact schema version, semver (patch may be omitted).
